description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a compassionate leader to oversee all nursing operations and ensure the delivery of high-quality patient care within a supportive environment.The Director of Nursing will be responsible for managing nursing staff, implementing clinical policies and procedures, and ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations. You will play a critical role in fostering a positive work environment and maintaining the highest standards of care for our residents.This urgent opening offers an annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, commensurate with experience. We are actively seeking candidates to connect with our hiring manager by June 30th.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 3-5 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
